facts.business: PNB Housing Finance Limited is India's third-largest housing finance company by loan assets, providing retail housing and non-housing loans through Prime, Emerging Markets, and Affordable Housing (Roshni) verticals, with a wholly owned subsidiary PHFL Home Loans and Services Ltd. as a distribution arm.
key_risks: Assessment of impairment loss allowance of expected credit losses (ECL) on loans involving significant management judgement and complex models under Ind AS 109
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions with Punjab National Bank for banking transactions, loan transactions, credit facilities, term deposits, external commercial borrowings, investment in securities, acceptance/placing of fixed deposits, payment of royalty fee, repayment of principal and interest on assignment of loans, approved for period from conclusion of 38th AGM until conclusion of 39th AGM.
